notes: Zone AUPRC on (zone, 6-h window) bags, day-block bootstrap over the UTC day of the window start.
Negatives are a deterministic 1-in-20 sample (positives all kept): prevalence is inflated about 10x vs the true 0.7%, so AUPRC, Brier and BSS refer to that universe and are not operational rates.
BSS reference = constant train positive rate (14.5%), not the zone-month climatology row.

ice.milcnn_calibrated uses the isotonic calibrator fitted on ALL of val: on val its Brier/ECE are in-sample (optimistic); on test they are out-of-sample. The raw row uses the val-chosen threshold 0.465 for CSI. Logistic/climatology CSI thresholds are the val-best thresholds of train-fit models.

No case_holdout set exists for ice (splits/ice.json extra.case_holdout is empty); no urban/rural split (no urban label in the bag table); no bridge-prior ablation (the prior is a routing-layer multiplier, not a separate checkpoint); no ice ablation checkpoints in models/.
Rule-vs-model is evaluated on identical windows (auprc_minus_physics_rule is a paired day-block CI).
Labels are NWS Storm Events weak labels (weather in zone), not road-surface ice.
